## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.4 lets you enroll code-backed topics with sentence titles and keeps them active in projects with display names such as “RFC756 Pilot”.

### Enroll sentence-named topics

Topic enrollment now accepts generated filenames whose sentence ends in a period, producing an internal double dot before the `.md` extension. Canonical path checks still reject unsafe, foreign, or malformed memory addresses.

### Keep named project topics active

Maintenance now finds active topics for projects whose display names differ from their storage-safe names, including when an inventory resumes. Projects with similar normalized names remain separated by their exact identities.
